question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Sage
solution: The correct answer is **"Foolish."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Sage"** means a wise person. (एक बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति) • **Example**: *I came across a **sage**__ on Monday.* • So, the antonym would be a word that means **foolish or lacking wisdom**. • **"Foolish"** means silly; not sensible. (बेवक़ूफ़; बेअक़ल, बुद्धिहीन, विवेकहीन) __ • **Example**: *I was **foolish**__ enough to trust him.* The correct answer is **Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ ** • **Option 1 (Useless)** means not having any use or purpose. (अनुपयोगी, बेकार (जो ठीक से काम न करे, जिससे कोई काम न सधे जो किसी काम का न हो)) • **Option 2 (Threatening)** means causing fear or danger. (धमकाने वाला, धमकी-भरा) • **Option 4 (Plain)** means simple or ordinary. (देखने, सुनने, समझने में आसान; स्‍पष्‍ट) 49:Ta4e, The correct answer is **"fare."**
